blocks.summary: oku 1.0 — the rename + the visual + content overhaul — is substantially shipped. The kit now covers 28 chart variants with rich-hover + click-pin + fullscreen pan/zoom; tables with kanban + column-resize + wrap-by-default; full Markdown parity including front-matter, footnotes, definition lists, nested lists, sanitised inline HTML; asymmetric-friendly wide-screen layout. This page tracks what's open, what's queued for 1.1 / 2.0, and the locked decisions.
bullets: Open: chart hover audit (gauge, radar, box-plot, bullet, slope still on bare title), sparkline parallel cursor, quadrant collision avoidance, live-snippet height inside example-pair, mermaid diagram example-pair layout.
Queued for 1.1: deprecation warning on html-doc CLI alias; bigger series palette work for >10-series charts; sankey chord/multi-row support.
Queued for 2.0: rename src/html_doc/ package → src/oku/; drop html-doc console-script.

Closed decisions: oku is the project name; layout option A (centered, four-mode width cycle); symmetric content widening (no asymmetric prose clamp); inline-HTML allowlist; lightbox uses CSS-transform pan/zoom.

blocks.title: Recent landings
blocks.lead: Highlights since the rename. Full per-commit history lives in git log.

items: Reference split — charts.json, tables.json, diagrams.json nested under reference via meta.parent.
Chart polish — extended series palette (10 tokens), click-to-pin tooltips, legend toggle on stacked / grouped bars.
Tier 3 charts — sankey, network, scatter-matrix, parallel-coordinates, chord, geo.

Mermaid pass — every v10 type documented, theme tokens (state / class / ER / journey / mindmap text colour), parse-error fixes on architecture diagrams, error-svg orphan purge, intrinsic-size strip so wide diagrams stop clipping at column edge.

Markdown parity — YAML front-matter, footnotes, definition lists, reference-style links, nested lists, sanitised inline HTML allowlist (a, code, em, strong, span, sup, sub, br, mark, kbd, samp, del, ins, abbr).

Tables — kanban / board view by default via view: 'board', drag-resize columns, word-wrap cells, compact icon view-toggle, Group label dropped, controls wrap rules so group drops below view+expand when narrow.
Wide-screen — symmetric widening (everything follows --content-width); breakpoints at 1500px / 1900px.
annotated-code — substring chip auto-place + tooltip via Prism-token-split-safe wrapping; multi-line tooltip position:fixed above the block, escapes ancestor clipping.
Lightbox — true fullscreen with wheel/pinch zoom + drag pan + keyboard, reused for image / chart / diagram / mermaid.
Inline HTML in rich-strings — anchors / kbd / mark / span / sup / sub / br / del / ins / abbr all auto-detected and rendered as inline nodes.

blocks.title: Locked decisions
blocks.lead: Each was an open question once; collected here so future contributors don't relitigate.

items: Project name = oku (Turkish 'read!'). Distribution name html-doc through 1.x; package rename in 2.0.
html-doc CLI alias sunset: silent through 0.x + 1.0; stderr deprecation note from 1.1; console-script removed in 2.0.
Layout = option A (centered document, four-mode content-width cycle: narrow / comfortable / wide / max).
Wide-screen widening is symmetric — every primitive follows --content-width. The earlier asymmetric prose clamp was retired.
P2 fullscreen uses CSS-transform pan/zoom on the inner stage (wheel zoom anchored at cursor, drag pan, pinch on touch, keyboard +/-/0/arrows). Not SVG-viewBox math.
P3 code/render pair = 2-column grid above 900px, stacked below. Tabs widget rejected — reader wants both at once.
P4 inline HTML allowlist over a full sanitisation pipeline. Allowed: a, code, em, strong, span, sup, sub, br, mark, kbd, samp, del, ins, abbr.
P5 Tier 3 viz — sankey, network, scatter-matrix, parallel-coordinates, chord, geo all shipped as kit-native chart types (no third-party chart library).
Charts / tables / diagrams are sub-pages of Reference (meta.parent: 'reference').

blocks.title: Principles
blocks.lead: Reader-, author-, and maintainer-facing rules every change honours.

items: Single LEFT sidebar — TOC + site tree stacked. No right TOC, no mid-edge tab.
Visual-first authoring. Pros/cons → comparison-cards, metrics → kpi-grid, trade-offs → table-with-chips. Paragraph + bullets is the fallback, not the default.
Every fix pairs with a regression test. Browser-level fixes ship with a Playwright assertion or, at minimum, a numeric bounding-box check captured in the commit message.
Numbers in counters / badges only — no English words baked into the kit.
No demo sibling pages. Every example for a primitive lives next to its heading.
No process / round / historical references in docs — describe current behaviour, not how it got there.
